# Highland Farms Oregon

> All-inclusive farm and forest wedding venue and outdoor Nordic sauna spa at the base of Mt. Hood — 21261 East Little River Road, Brightwood, Oregon 97011, about an hour from Portland and about 25 minutes from Government Camp. The five-acre property is home to Scottish Highland Cows and old-growth forest, with on-site lodging for up to 20 guests, private Highland Cow farm tours, and a wood-burning cedar sauna + cold plunge. Contact: events@highlandfarms-oregon.com or +1 (831) 214-2053.

## About

Highland Farms is a transformed cedar mill property at the base of Mt. Hood, nestled in the forest valley of Brightwood, Oregon. The farm is home to Scottish Highland Cows, Icelandic Sheep, White Peacocks, guardian dogs, chickens, and Guinea Fowl. The property includes a restored historic lodge, a cozy cottage, and a glamping camp — all surrounded by towering old-growth evergreens and accessed via a private road.

Highland Farms was featured by LivePDX and has 29,000+ Instagram followers at @highlandfarmsor.

## How Highland Farms Compares

- **vs. a typical Oregon wedding venue:** Exclusive-use and all-inclusive — one wedding at a time, the entire 5-acre property yours, on-site lodging for your closest guests, and dedicated event coordination included rather than à la carte. The old-growth forest and Scottish Highland Cow setting is not something a ballroom or vineyard offers.
- **vs. an indoor Portland spa or bathhouse:** The Nordic Forest Spa is a wood-burning cedar sauna, wet sauna, and cold plunge set in an old-growth forest about an hour from Portland. It's a public, Scandinavian-style shared session (90 minutes, up to 6 guests) — what sets it apart is being fully outdoors in the Mt. Hood forest, not an indoor city facility with locker rooms.
- **vs. a public farm tour or petting zoo:** Farm tours are private (up to 6 guests, 60 minutes) and hands-on with Scottish Highland Cows, Icelandic Sheep, White Peacocks, guardian dogs, chickens, and Guinea Fowl.

## Weddings & Events

- [Weddings](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/weddings): All-inclusive farm and forest wedding packages. Exchange vows under towering evergreens with Highland Cow photo opportunities. Venue includes exclusive 5-acre property access, on-site lodging for 20 guests, full kitchen access, ceremony and reception areas, and dedicated event coordination.
- [Celebrations & Events](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/celebrations): Host engagement parties, birthdays, rehearsal dinners, anniversaries, celebrations of life, and retreats.
- [Wedding Portfolio](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/wedding-portfolio): Browse real weddings at Highland Farms featuring couples who celebrated in the forest and farm setting.
- [Wedding Look Book (PDF)](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/lookbook.pdf): Full wedding look book with venue photos, packages, and details.

## Experiences

- [Highland Cow Farm Tours](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/farm-tours): Private 60-minute farm tours for up to 6 guests ($75/person). Meet Scottish Highland Cows, Icelandic Sheep, White Peacocks, guardian dogs, chickens, and Guinea Fowl. Book via Acuity Scheduling.
- [Nordic Forest Spa](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/nordic-spa): Public, Scandinavian-style 90-minute Nordic spa sessions for up to 6 guests ($75/person) — a wood-burning cedar dry sauna, wet sauna, and cold plunge nestled among towering evergreens. Sessions are shared, so you may share your slot with other guests. (Separately, the Lodge and Cottage accommodations each have a private cedar hot tub — not part of the Nordic Forest Spa.)
- [Sauna Near Portland](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/sauna-near-portland): The Nordic Forest Spa as a day trip from Portland — a public outdoor wood-burning sauna and cold plunge roughly an hour from the city, at the base of Mt. Hood.
- [Gift Certificates](https://highlandfarms.as.me/schedule/e759f21b): Give the gift of a Highland Farms experience.

## Accommodations

- [Stay Overview](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/stay): Three accommodations nestled among towering evergreens — the Lodge, the Cottage and the Camp — bookable individually or together as the Whole Farm. Book direct for the best rate.
- [The Lodge](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/stay/lodge): Historic cedar mill lodge sleeping 8 guests across 4 bedrooms and 2.5 baths. Features a spacious family room, dining area, full kitchen, private cedar hot tub, and outdoor forest deck.
- [The Cottage](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/stay/cottage): Cozy retreat near The Lodge with 3 bedrooms, 1 bath, kitchenette, and private cedar hot tub. Sleeps 8 guests. Perfect for families or a peaceful forest getaway.
- [The Camp](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/stay/camp): Glamping experience with a restored Airstream trailer and canvas tent camping under towering evergreens. Sleeps 4 guests.
- [The Whole Farm](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/stay/whole-farm): Reserve the entire property for up to 20 guests. Exclusive access to all accommodations, the farm, and the forest. Perfect for weddings, retreats, and large gatherings.

## Farm Store

- [Shop](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/shop): Highland Farms merchandise including apparel, weighted Highland Cow plushies, fresh farm eggs, Highland beef, Mangalitsa pork, and firewood. Orders are placed and paid for on this site. Fulfillment is free pickup at the farm in Brightwood, or local delivery ($15) within the Mt. Hood corridor and east Portland metro. Highland Farms does not ship.

## Key Facts

- Location: Brightwood, Oregon (Mt. Hood corridor)
- Distance from Portland: about 1 hour
- Distance from Government Camp: about 25 minutes
- Property size: 5 acres of forest and farmland
- Maximum guest capacity: 20 overnight (Lodge 8 + Cottage 8 + Camp 4); up to 125 for day events such as weddings
- Animals: Scottish Highland Cows, Icelandic Sheep, White Peacocks, guardian dogs, chickens, Guinea Fowl
- Accommodations: The Lodge (8 guests), The Cottage (8 guests), The Camp (4 guests), Whole Farm (20 guests — all three together)
- Nordic Forest Spa: 90-minute public, shared sessions, up to 6 guests, $75/person — wood-burning cedar dry sauna, wet sauna, and cold plunge
- Nordic Forest Spa availability: not a fixed weekly schedule. Session days vary because weddings and events on the property block the spa calendar (Saturdays are the most affected). Check the live booking link below for real availability rather than assuming set hours.
- Farm Tours: 60-minute private tours, 2–6 guests, $75/person (the smallest bookable tour is for two people, $150)
- Cancellation policy (farm tours and spa sessions): Strict. All bookings are final — no refunds, no reschedules, no credits, and no transfers, for cancellations, date changes or no-shows. Please confirm your date, time and guest count before booking. The only exception is if we cancel for severe weather or for the safety of our animals or guests, in which case we will refund or rebook you.
- Cancellation policy (accommodations): Terms vary by property and booking date, and are provided at the time of booking. The strict tours-and-spa policy above does not apply to lodging.
- Cancellation policy (weddings and events): Set out in the individual event agreement. Deposits are generally non-refundable. Contact the events team for specific terms.
- Farm tour booking: https://highlandfarms.as.me/schedule/e759f21b
- Spa booking: https://highlandfarms.as.me/schedule/e759f21b/appointment/85942611/calendar/13047082
